_comment: Contract between you and Claude for the bowl-holder. Claude regenerates the scripts from this; edit freely. Follows templates/spec.json, plus an additive 'companion_parts' key because this project ships two printed parts.
name: bowl-holder
description: A footed collar that holds a 6 in (152.4 mm) stainless mixing bowl. The bowl is lowered through the top bore and its rim lands on an internal seat lip; below the seat the bore opens back up so the bowl body hangs free. The lower outside carries a fluted decorative band, the base is an arcaded plinth whose piers are the feet, and two lugs on the X axis carry blind sockets for slot-in ears (a separate appendage part). A matching fluted collar band prints separately and slides down over the ring's plain upper wall.

bowl_diameter.description: Rim diameter of the bowl the ring wraps

fit_clearance.description: Radial gap between the bowl rim and the bore

wall_thickness.description: Radial thickness of the ring wall

total_height.description: Overall height, bottom of the feet to the top rim

lip_width.description: How far the seat lip reaches in under the bowl rim

lip_height.description: Height of the seat lip; its underside is the print-safe taper

flute_count.description: Number of scalloped flutes in the decorative band

flute_depth.description: Depth of each flute, capped at 40% of the wall

feet_count.description: Number of feet (piers) around the arcaded base

foot_height.description: Height of the arcaded base zone

socket_diameter.description: Diameter of the slot-in ear sockets in the top rim lugs

socket_depth.description: Depth of the ear sockets below the top rim

features: bore sized to bowl_diameter + 2 * fit_clearance (154.0 mm at defaults)
internal seat lip with a self-supporting tapered underside, so the bowl rim hangs on it
plain upper wall above the seat that captures the rim (and is where the collar band rides)
fluted decorative band around the lower outside, count and depth parameterized
arcaded plinth base: feet_count round-topped arches leaving feet_count piers
flared foot at the very bottom for bed adhesion and a plinth read
two ear lugs on the X axis with domed undersides, each carrying one blind ear socket in the top rim

derived_geometry._comment: Values build() computes from the parameters rather than exposing as knobs, so no combination of the declared ranges can collapse the profile.
derived_geometry.upper_wall: clamp(0.16 * total_height, 4, 22), also capped at 0.25 * total_height
derived_geometry.flute_depth_effective: min(flute_depth, 0.40 * wall_thickness, 0.45 * flute_surface_width) -- the 40% cap is what makes a flute physically unable to reach the bore
derived_geometry.band_zone: from foot_height_effective + 2 up to seat_z - 3, capped at 0.5 * total_height; skipped below 3 mm

appendage_slots._comment: The ears are a later appendage part. Peg is nominal; the socket is the peg plus the printer's slide_fit, and 1 mm deeper than the peg is long so the ear seats on its shoulder, not on the hole bottom.

print.orientation: as modelled, feet on the bed
notes: Both parts fit the Centauri Carbon's 256 x 256 x 256 bed at every declared parameter value; the widest case measured is 246 mm.
The seat lip underside, the arcade tops and the lug undersides are all curved or tapered so the part is intended to print without support.

companion_parts.name: bowl-holder-collar-band
companion_parts.description: A decorative sleeve carrying the same flute family as the ring's band, sized to slide down over the base ring's outer wall and sit on its plain upper section.
features: plain rim above and below the flutes
fluted zone matching the base ring's texture family
chamfer on all four rim circles

mates_to.rule: ring_outer_diameter = bowl_diameter + 2 * (fit_clearance + wall_thickness) = 164.0 mm at defaults

ring_outer_diameter.description: Outer diameter of the base ring this collar wraps

slide_fit.description: Radial clearance on the bore so the collar slides on

wall_thickness.description: Radial thickness of the collar wall

band_height.description: Height of the collar along Z

rim_height.description: Plain rim above and below the flutes

flute_count.description: Number of scalloped flutes around the collar

flute_depth.description: Depth of each flute, capped at 40% of the wall

edge_chamfer.description: Chamfer breaking the four rim circles; 0 leaves them sharp
